from collections import Counter

def solve():
    n = int(input())
    v = list(map(int, input().split()))
    
    half = n // 2
    
    even_vals = [v[i] for i in range(0, n, 2)]
    odd_vals = [v[i] for i in range(1, n, 2)]
    
    even_cnt = Counter(even_vals)
    odd_cnt = Counter(odd_vals)
    
    # Get top 2 for each
    even_top = even_cnt.most_common(2)
    odd_top = odd_cnt.most_common(2)
    
    best_even_val, best_even_count = even_top[0]
    best_odd_val, best_odd_count = odd_top[0]
    
    if best_even_val != best_odd_val:
        cost = (half - best_even_count) + (half - best_odd_count)
    else:
        # They're the same, must try alternatives
        # Option 1: keep best for even, use second best for odd
        if len(odd_top) > 1:
            second_odd_count = odd_top[1][1]
        else:
            second_odd_count = 0
        cost1 = (half - best_even_count) + (half - second_odd_count)
        
        # Option 2: use second best for even, keep best for odd
        if len(even_top) > 1:
            second_even_count = even_top[1][1]
        else:
            second_even_count = 0
        cost2 = (half - second_even_count) + (half - best_odd_count)
        
        cost = min(cost1, cost2)
    
    print(cost)

solve()
